given_when_then.given: A Platform Operator initiates the creation of a new Service Area Definition using valid geographic coordinates
given_when_then.when: The system processes the request and validates the input against active Service Area Definitions and regulatory restricted zones
given_when_then.then: The new Service Area Definition is saved with an 'Inactive' status until explicitly activated by an authorized user

given_when_then.given: A Platform Operator attempts to create a Service Area Definition whose boundaries overlap with a restricted zone defined by the Regulatory Authority
given_when_then.when: The system processes the request and checks for regulatory zone conflicts
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the Service Area Definition creation and prevents saving the record

given_when_then.given: A Platform Operator initiates the creation of a new Service Area Definition using a valid radius and center coordinates
given_when_then.when: The system processes the request and calculates the circular boundary
given_when_then.then: The new Service Area Definition is saved with an 'Inactive' status until explicitly activated by an authorized user

success_criteria: A Service Area Definition created by an authorized user is saved with an 'Inactive' status by default.
Service Area Definition creation is rejected if the defined geographic boundaries overlap with a restricted zone defined by the Regulatory Authority.
Service Area Definition creation is supported for both geographic boundaries and radius configurations.
